Your first step into the story

A fragment.
A beginning.

Primer in development

The adventure starts here. The rest is what you make of it.

Fragments of the Fallen is Ugmul's Dungeons & Dragons campaign. This page will be your introduction to its world, the kind of adventure ahead, and how to create a character with a place in the story.

The player primer is being written. The themes below are a proposed direction for this page, ready to shape around the campaign's approved pitch.

A first look · Proposed themes

Come for the adventure.
Stay for the story.

I.

Follow the mystery

Questions worth asking. Clues worth chasing. A world that invites you to look a little closer.

II.

Leave your mark

A character with a reason to act, people to care about, and choices that belong to you.

III.

Share the adventure

Build a party, face the unknown together, and make the moments your table will remember.
